Game Overview

World of Alice - Make Words is a educational title where join Alice on an enchanting vocabulary-building adventure. Drag letters to craft simple words, enhancing spelling and vocabulary skills. With an engaging interface suitable for all devices, children can delight in word-making challenges while learning in a playful, confidence-boosting environment. Unleash creativity and language mastery with ease!
